description:
Posthive lets you schedule and publish social media posts across 13 platforms — Bluesky, Threads, Instagram, LinkedIn, Mastodon, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Pinterest, Telegram, Nostr, X (Twitter), Discord, Tumblr and more all from one place.

Ask ChatGPT to draft a post, pick your accounts, and schedule it for the right time. You can create drafts for human review, approve and schedule them, update or reschedule pending posts, and manage post templates. Everything stays in your Posthive queue so nothing publishes without your control.

defaultPrompt: Schedule a post to all my connected social accounts for tomorrow morning
Show me all my upcoming scheduled posts
Create a draft post for my Bluesky and LinkedIn accounts
